title: AI for Laboratory Operations
summary: AI for laboratory operations: knowledge discovery, safety intelligence, and accountable decision support.
body: AI for Laboratory Operations brings together research on retrieval, agentic reasoning, safety analysis, and governance to support operational excellence and predictive maintenance in laboratory environments.

title: AI for HPC
summary: Trustworthy multi-agent operational analytics and telemetry-informed decision support for high-performance computing.
body: Our AI for HPC research explores trustworthy operational analytics, multi-agent architectures, and defensible decisions from HPC telemetry.

title: Agentic Cosmological Simulation on Frontier
summary: COSMOAGENT connects natural-language scientific goals with expert-supervised cosmological simulations on Frontier.
body: A multi-agent workflow for planning, configuring, executing, debugging, and analyzing cosmological simulations, with scientists retaining control of critical decisions.

title: QuantumScience Claw (QSC)
summary: A locally deployed scientific agent for verifiable quantum error-correction workflows.
body: Ethan Seefried and Tirthankar Ghosal lead QuantumScience Claw, connecting a local language-model agent to controlled, verifiable quantum error-correction operations.
